run_tsne_visualization: run the tsne module to generate a 2D visualization of features from a features file
run_mds_visualization: run the mds module to generate a 2D visualization of features with cluster labels
normalize_features: normalize features by subtracting the mean and dividing by the standard deviation
get_tsne_embeddings: get 2D t-SNE embeddings from high-dimensional feature data using sklearn TSNE
plot_embeddings: plot 2D embeddings as a scatter plot with optional cluster labels and save to file
